source: Progression des apprentissages au primaire, ministère de l'Éducation du Québec: Mathématique (2009) and Français, langue d'enseignement (2009, oral 2011). Hand-encoded for the hub on 27 Nov 2026; codes are ours (section letter + item number).

legend.marks: One character per grade, 1re to 6e: '.' not taught, '>' learns it with the teacher (→), '*' does it alone by the end of the year (★), '+' reuses it.
legend.windows: Months (9 = September … 6 = June) when the skill is worked on in that grade; our estimate, editable. Grades without a window use: '>' → November to June, '*' → September to June, '+' → none (upkeep only).
